actual_scope: This scoped optimum extends the five-term finite-commutative tariff to every finite associative unital ring. It covers all positive, stationary, coefficient-independent directional prices and arbitrary finite gate words. Left-ideal principality and ordered coefficients determine the one-insertion terms.
